title: bagu-trainer ticket (stages/stage-NN/ticket.yaml)
description: Design v0.4 §4.3. Namespaced by concern: identity/brief/scope/grader/hints/submission/mentor_policy/progression. Version anchors (schema_version, ticket_version, grader.correctness.test_version) are frozen into the TicketInstance at issue time (§9.1). Unlock is a DAG via progression.prerequisites (v0.3 reverses the old forward-pointing unlock_next).

identity.description: Identity + version anchors, pinned into TicketInstance (§9.1) to answer 'which version is this PR/report based on'.

ticket_version.description: Content version of THIS ticket; changing the brief/grader bumps it and stales old Instances (§9.2).

brief.description: Problem statement the AI manager turns into an issued exam.

scope.description: Bounded change surface — drives review and out-of-scope detection (§7.3).

files_to_change.description: Files the learner may modify. D1: the AI mentor NEVER writes these.

grader.description: Objective red/green criteria, run locally on the learner's machine. Their result is treated as UNTRUSTED evidence (§7.4).

test_version.description: Canonical-test version; pinned with ticket_version into the Instance.

performance.description: EXPLAIN-based performance assertion, or null when not applicable.

hints.description: Ladder hints; collapsed by default, expanding one is recorded into the learner profile.

title.description: Short label shown on the collapsed summary ('提示 1：事务边界'). Optional: without it the UI falls back to '提示 N'. A hint nobody can label is a hint nobody opens.

require.description: Required defense artifacts (e.g. changed SQL, index column order + rationale, before/after EXPLAIN).

bagu_map_ref.description: Anchor into bagu-map.md; validated to exist (§4.6).

mentor_policy.description: Per-ticket mentor permissions (§6.4); the hard constraint of D1 role reversal.

may_write.description: Files the mentor may write. MUST NOT intersect scope.files_to_change (D1).

progression.description: Unlock dependencies. v0.3 reverses unlock_next: a ticket declares WHO IT DEPENDS ON, forming a DAG; unlock check = 'all prerequisites passed' (§9.2). A single prerequisite degenerates to linear.

prerequisites.description: Ticket ids that must be passed before this ticket becomes available.
